title: Seeing Hadestown in the same city I once played Orpheus just hits dif...
transcript: I've said it once and I'll say it again I love HadesTown Teen Editions oh my gosh the talent the creativity I just saw HadesTown Teen Edition tonight at the Colorado Springs Fine Art Centre they have one more performance tomorrow if you are in Colorado Springs but this is the third HadesTown Teen Edition production that I've seen and all three of them so vastly different so many incredible choices I love what people are doing with Hadestown I love how much the teens get to like have fun with the show this production of Hadestown is also the most set pieces that I've seen in a Hadestown like usually it's the one unit set and all of the other productions that I've seen kind of stick to that this had like this backdrop that came in this was kind of the base set that almost looked like this abandoned church but that was overrun with garbage so there was a lot of of junk motif in the set pieces that they would bring on in the costumes there were six fates in this production and all of them were dressed in like crafting supplies so they had these these headdresses some of them had yarn attached to theirs some of them had Scissors some of them had rulers which was such a a great choice of them crafting the fate of all of these characters two of my absolute favourite moments from this production were one anytime Persephone came on during spring this flower curtain would drop down and when Hades comes to pick her up and they're leaving he like snapped and the curtain flew away and the the lighting was like this like really rich reds and greens and smoke came in and it was just it was such a cool moment I gasped that was my HadesTown gasp tonight and my second favourite moment is that in all I've ever known during the dance sequence Orpheus and Eurydice did this really simple and gorgeous dance together and during Flowers Eurydice did the choreography by herself and I broke I absolutely broke also spoiler alert for Hades Town if you've never seen it before uh but I always love seeing how Teen Edition productions do the turn and in this one there actually is a trap door in this stage and so Orpheus and Eurydice are walking along the back and Orpheus goes past this like flap this flap that they brought out that's like covered in junk that was part of the above world set design and as soon as he passes that he turned and she instead of walking across walked down the trap door with the flower and he like went out to like try to grab her and the flower and uh you just saw the flower like going down into the ground it was haunting beautiful beautiful choice for that moment I just what a great what a great production the cast is super talented and I just I love hadestown teen editions I'm so glad I got to see this one and if you're in Colorado Springs you got one more night one more night tomorrow
